findings.item: Taiwan 10Y government bond yield, monthly series May-2021 to Sep-2026 (CBC '十年期政府公債次級市場利率', monthly AVERAGE, % p.a.)
findings.as_of: CBC database last_updated 2026-10-28; latest period 2026M09; retrieved 2026-11-02
findings.source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), statistical database table '29.利率 G.資本市場利率依期間' (EG43M01); underlying data from TPEx
findings.note: I pulled the raw JSON myself; these are not values summarized by a model. Basis: monthly average, not month-end. The same series appears in the CBC Annual Report 2018 key-indicators table under the heading '10-year Gov't Bond Rate in Secondary Market (average)', and its 2018 monthly values match the API exactly (https://www.cbc.gov.tw/en/public/Attachment/961413374871.PDF). CBC footnote: the yield of the government bond closest to 10 years from maturity, sourced from TPEx (https://www.cbc.gov.tw/public/data/economic/statistics/key/interest-y.pdf). The CBC has not yet published October 2026. API guide: https://cpx.cbc.gov.tw/Data/ExportToAPIInfo

findings.item: Taiwan 10Y simple average, May-2021 to Sep-2026 (65 months, CBC monthly averages)
findings.value: 1.289% (sum of monthly values 83.79 / 65)
findings.source_name: Computed from CBC EG43M01 monthly series
findings.note: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the 65 CBC monthly values listed above. October 2026 is left out because the CBC has not released it.

findings.item: Taiwan 10Y simple average, May-2021 to Oct-2026 (66 months, using a proxy for October 2026)
findings.value: 1.300% = (83.79 + 2.006) / 66. The October value 2.006% is the mean of 21 Investing.com daily closes, 2026-10-02 to 10-30. Using the 10-30 level of 1.99% for October instead gives 1.2997%.
findings.source_name: Computed from CBC EG43M01 (May-21 to Sep-26) plus Investing.com daily closes (Oct-26)
findings.note: The October proxy uses a different basis: daily closes of the benchmark bond on an aggregator, against the CBC's monthly average for the bond nearest 10 years. The result barely moves with the proxy: any October value from 1.97 to 2.01 gives 1.299 to 1.300.

findings.item: Taiwan 10Y annual averages (CBC official annual figures)
findings.value: 2021 0.44 | 2022 1.09 | 2023 1.21 | 2024 1.43 | 2025 1.45 (% p.a.). The CBC publishes no 2026 YTD figure. My computed mean of CBC Jan-Sep 2026 monthly values is 1.66.
findings.source_name: CBC statistical database EG43Y01 (annual), matching CBC interest-y.pdf
findings.note: CONFLICT within the CBC's own data. Means of the CBC monthly values (my computation): 2021 0.44 (full year), 2022 1.22, 2023 1.22, 2024 1.51, 2025 1.47; May-Dec 2021 alone is 0.47. The official annual figures differ materially for 2022 (1.09 vs 1.22) and 2024 (1.43 vs 1.51). The CBC does not document how it weights the annual figure; daily or volume weighting is a plausible but unverified explanation. For a simple monthly average, use the monthly series. Cite the official annual numbers only when annual figures are wanted.

findings.item: Taiwan 10Y yield level on 2026-10-30
findings.source_name: Trading Economics (Taiwan 10Y Bond Yield page)
findings.note: The page summary says the yield 'eased to 1.99% on October 30, 2026', down 0.02pp on the day, up 0.02pp over the month and up 0.72pp over the year. findings.value: Total loans NT$2,838.9bn: +16.12% YoY, +7.93% YTD. FX loans +40.09% YoY; corporate +20.09%; SME +14.12%; personal +11.37%; mortgages +6.53%. Total deposits NT$3,988.6bn, +15.00% YoY.
findings.source_name: E.SUN FHC 2Q26 deck, slide 14 (存放款業務比較)
findings.note: Totals are bank consolidated; corporate and personal splits are bank standalone. Overseas branch and subsidiary loans grew 20.5% YTD.

findings.item: E.SUN Bank: NPL ratio, coverage ratio and credit cost
findings.value: NPL ratio 0.15% (NPL NT$4,192m); coverage 770.8% (2025: 826.4%); annualised credit cost 0.19% (provisions NT$2,710m)
findings.source_name: E.SUN FHC 2Q26 deck, slide 22 (資產品質)
findings.note: Bank standalone. 3Q25 press cited NPL 0.15% and coverage above 800%.

findings.item: E.SUN Bank: capital ratios (BIS CAR, Tier 1, CET1)
findings.source_name: E.SUN FHC 2Q26 deck, slide 12 (資本適足率)
findings.note: Bank standalone. CET1 is given as a footnote (普通股權益比率 10.91%). CAR was 15.42% at 2025 and 16.05% at 6M25. The bank has FSC approval for credit-risk IRB.

findings.item: E.SUN FHC: group capital adequacy and double-leverage ratio
findings.source_name: E.SUN FHC 2Q26 deck, slides 5 and 12
findings.note: These are pre-merger figures. No post-merger (3Q26) group CAR or DLR has been published.

findings.item: E.SUN FHC: pre-merger balance sheet
findings.value: Total assets NT$4,871,197m; equity attributable NT$281,790m; BVPS NT$17.40 (2025-12: NT$16.86)
findings.source_name: E.SUN FHC 2Q26 deck, slide 5 and Appendix 3
findings.note: Slide 5 shows a typo for FHC total assets at 2025-12 (4,116,533); the appendix balance sheet shows 4,516,533, which is consistent with the bank's 4,466,652.

findings.item: E.SUN FHC: post-merger total assets
findings.value: FHC NT$6.65tn; E.SUN Bank (consolidated) NT$5.04tn
findings.source_name: Liberty Times 2026-10-15 and uanalyze 2026-10-15, quoting E.SUN's September 自結 release
findings.note: Also at https://uanalyze.com.tw/articles/9550957167. These are the first figures that include Mercuries Life, consolidated from 2026-09-01.

findings.item: E.SUN FHC: 9M26 self-reported earnings (first release with Mercuries Life)
findings.value: 9M26 NI NT$31.85bn (+21.54% YoY), EPS 1.95. September NI NT$3.81bn. E.SUN Bank 9M NT$27.95bn (+10.79%). Mercuries Life standalone: Sept NT$1.911bn, 9M NT$6.023bn; amount recognised in FHC consolidated for Sept: NT$0.144bn.
findings.source_name: uanalyze 2026-10-15; Liberty Times 2026-10-15
findings.note: The company attributes the gap between standalone and consolidated earnings to IFRS 3 remeasurement at fair value on the merger date. It describes this as a one-time adjustment concentrated in the merger period.

findings.item: Mercuries Life (三商美邦人壽): RBC before the merger and injection (old regime)
findings.value: RBC 154% at 2025-06-30, against a 200% statutory minimum. Year-end 2025 was only guided as 'close to 200%' after NT$18.5bn of sub-debt and equity raising.
findings.source_name: uanalyze 2025-11-10 (E.SUN 3Q25 investor conference); Commercial Times 2026-01-23 for the year-end estimate
findings.note: A search-result summary cited 154.27% RBC and a 2.31% net worth ratio at 1H25, but the URL could not be verified (low). No actual end-2025 RBC was found. Year-end estimate source: https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20260123700900-430503.

findings.item: Mercuries Life: TW-ICS (TIS) ratio before the capital injection
findings.value: TIS 110% at 2026-06-30, the lowest of the 14 life insurers using optional transitional measures; statutory minimum 100%
findings.source_name: Economic Daily News (經濟日報) 2026-10-01
findings.note: uanalyze 2026-10-08 (https://uanalyze.com.tw/articles/6551256787) also gives 110%, last among 21 insurers. Insurers using transitional measures must cap their disclosed TIS at the target ratio filed with the regulator (uanalyze 2026-10-06, https://uanalyze.com.tw/articles/9675356622). The 110% may therefore be a cap rather than the actual ratio.

findings.item: Mercuries Life: capital injection and the ratio expected afterwards
findings.value: NT$16bn injected on 2026-09-29 (780m new shares at NT$20.512821, 100% subscribed by E.SUN FHC); a further NT$6bn is planned for 2027 (NT$22bn total). After the injection E.SUN projects TIS of 125% at end-2026. The chairman's projection after both tranches is RBC above 250% on the old basis and a net worth ratio above 10%.
findings.source_name: Economic Daily News / CNA 2026-09-29; uanalyze 2026-09-24 and 2026-10-08
findings.note: All post-injection ratios are projections; no actual post-injection TIS has been published yet. TechNews 2026-08-13 calls the 125% 'RBC', which conflicts with the other reports. I trust the TIS label, because RBC was replaced by TW-ICS in 2026 and 125% would be below the old 200% RBC floor.

findings.item: Mercuries Life: equity and net worth ratio under IFRS 17 (pre-injection)
findings.value: 1H26 self-reported equity NT$120.0bn and net worth ratio 8.80%, up NT$55.3bn from the IFRS 17 opening. 1H26 NI NT$5.1bn. At end-April 2026: equity NT$86.7bn (6.46%); adjusted equity including CSM NT$139.0bn (10.35%). CSM NT$61.0bn at opening and NT$64.4bn at end-1Q26.
findings.source_name: China Times Wealth 2026-07-15 and 2026-06-03
findings.note: End-April data: https://wantrich.chinatimes.com/news/20260603900714-420101. The IFRS 17 opening moved the net worth ratio from 2.85% to 4.80%. Mercuries Life FY2025 NI was NT$1.18bn and total assets NT$1.66tn (Liberty Times 2026-01-15).

findings.item: E.SUN–Mercuries Life deal terms and timeline
findings.value: Share swap of 0.2486 E.SUN shares per Mercuries Life share (about NT$8.2 per share, about NT$48.3bn total, at the Jan-2026 EGMs). FTC approval 2026-04-04; FSC approval 2026-07-07; record date 2026-09-01; renamed E.SUN Life on 2026-12-01.
findings.source_name: Commercial Times 2026-01-23; E.SUN 2Q26 deck slide 28
findings.note: A search summary said some July and August reports give 0.2596, which may be an adjustment for E.SUN's stock dividend. That is unverified, so use the official MOPS filing. E.SUN's chairman said capital was NT$177.2bn after the merger (TechNews and uanalyze); whether this means 股本 is not stated.

findings.item: E.SUN 3Q26 financial statements, investor conference and acquisition accounting
findings.value: Neither 3Q26 consolidated statements nor a 3Q26 investor conference had been found as of 2026-11-02. The latest disclosure is the September self-reported earnings (2026-10-15). No amounts for goodwill or bargain-purchase gain have been disclosed.
findings.source_name: Searches of the press and MOPS deck paths; latest E.SUN release via Liberty Times 2026-10-15
findings.note: For timing reference, the 3Q25 conference was held 2025-11-10 (SETN/Yahoo). The Oct-15 release mentions only an IFRS 3 fair-value remeasurement at the merger date.
